verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a narrow API surface: custom integration push APIs with integration monitoring, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, and inbound webhooks that trigger ingestion workflows. Most documented functionality (access reviews, vendor risk assessments, audit partner selection, AI-system governance, task assignment) is described only as UI 'dashboard actions', and the probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core UI workflows (controls, policies, risks, tasks, access reviews, audits, AI-system governance), a published OpenAPI spec, any statement of API/UI parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
